# Authored Office module input

`office-modules.xlsm` is a deterministic synthetic package, not a downloaded
workbook. Its relocated package parts and reversed compound-file allocations
exercise source identity independently of conventional filenames and offsets.

It was generated by `book` in
`crates/rootlight-service/src/container_sources/fixture.rs` using the ordered
`Alpha` and `Beta` module byte strings retained in
`office_modules_preserve_exact_sources_and_origins_across_processes`.
Generator source SHA-256:
`9892cf7287a9efed368092b583e2441136fd4e5b634bdc1fb94a55ccd56d14d5`.
Package SHA-256:
`28b9fa3cb50f5a86ef52bc0922a646abcc60adcba8bfe0f44e8dd22db3ffee7a`.

The process test compiles only crate-local inputs. It verifies both module
bodies and generation-bound reads of the exact original package bytes.
